column1: # Pinned Muse Code 1.4.2 `muse --help` root option inventory.
# against the stable channel manifest, 2026-10-04): `muse resume --help` is
# byte-identical to 1.4.1's, and `muse --help` differs only by the added
# `model-profile` subcommand. Every root option below keeps its 1.4.1
# arity, so ElevateResumeIntent classifies both verified releases alike.
# `muse resume --help` adds only --last; root options may appear on either
# side of resume. Cardinality: exactly resume --last |
# resume <session-ref>; bare `resume` is the picker form and stays refused
# (contract r2 section 2); any second positional refuses. `-w, --worktree`
# takes an optional value (off|create|existing) and is classified in code.
